---
name: App or translation
about: Suggest an app, offer a new app, or add a language
labels: app, translation
---

**Type**
- [ ] New app idea
- [ ] New app I wrote
- [ ] New language
- [ ] Fix to an existing translation

**Details**
App name and what it does, or the language code (for example `de`, `pt_BR`).

**Link**
Repository or file, if you have one.

**Checklist**
- [ ] `appsctl validate` passes
- [ ] No tokens, personal data or Kobo binaries included
- [ ] Not a right-to-left language (not supported yet)
